# AUROC tables (generated by scripts/make_tables.py, v2)

Every likelihood cell: value ± 1σ, σ = std over 200 question-level bootstrap replicates (length regression refitted in each); per answer / matched k=10 / matched k=30; one uniform text filter; folded cells folded inside each replicate; null rows = within-question label permutation of the exact estimator; classifier rows (HM) = Hanley–McNeil error over trials, a Monte-Carlo error conditional on the finite pool, not a data uncertainty.
